rows.proof_boundary: Here r_0=1/zeta(1+alpha); A_alpha is the weighted Mobius prefix, not the reciprocal partial sum denoted A_(omega,N) in the Burnol tail-discrepancy note.
rows.statement: For 0<alpha<1 set a_n=mu(n)n^(-alpha), A_alpha(N)=sum_(n<=N)a_n, r_N=sum_(n>N)a_n/n, E_alpha=sum N^(alpha-2)|A_alpha(N)|^2, and R_alpha=sum N^alpha|r_N|^2.

rows.proof_boundary: Subtract two adjacent absolutely convergent reciprocal tails.
rows.statement: r_(N-1)-r_N=a_N/N for every N>=1.

rows.proof_boundary: Multiply row 2 by N and telescope. This couples all earlier cutoffs and restores the constant prefix mode.
rows.statement: A_alpha(N)=sum_(j=0)^(N-1)r_j-N*r_N.

rows.proof_boundary: This is row 3 divided by N in weighted l2 coordinates.
rows.statement: With b_N=A_alpha(N)/N and s_N=r_(N-1), b_N=H(s)(N)-r_N, where H(s)(N)=N^(-1)sum_(j=1)^N s_j.

rows.proof_boundary: Discrete Abel summation; A_alpha(n)/n tends to zero unconditionally for alpha>0.
rows.statement: r_N=-A_alpha(N)/(N+1)+sum_(n>N)A_alpha(n)/(n(n+1)).

rows.proof_boundary: A nonsharp explicit weighted Hardy bound obtained by the same Schur test used in the checked OU/Mertens reduction.
rows.statement: On l2(N^alpha), H has norm at most h_alpha=sqrt(2(3-alpha))/(1-alpha).

rows.proof_boundary: A nonsharp weighted Copson bound; the shifted kernel 1/(n+1) in row 5 is pointwise dominated by this positive kernel after shifting the output index.
rows.statement: The tail operator Cb(N)=sum_(n>=N)b_n/n has norm at most c_alpha=sqrt(2(3+alpha))/(1+alpha) on l2(N^alpha).

rows.proof_boundary: Rows 4-7 and the one-step weight shift; r_0 is finite for every alpha>0.
rows.statement: E_alpha<infinity iff R_alpha<infinity. Quantitatively, R_alpha^(1/2)<=(1+c_alpha)E_alpha^(1/2), while E_alpha^(1/2)<=(1+2^(alpha/2)h_alpha)(|r_0|^2+R_alpha)^(1/2).

rows.proof_boundary: This is BTDR.8 with precisely the same reciprocal tail r_N.
rows.statement: For alpha=2omega, the stable-prefix Burnol energy is P_(omega,N)=r_N^2*sum_(k<=N)k^alpha.

rows.proof_boundary: Use N^(1+alpha)/(1+alpha)<=sum_(k<=N)k^alpha<=N^(1+alpha).
rows.statement: (1/(1+alpha))*N^alpha*r_N^2<=P_(omega,N)/N<=N^alpha*r_N^2.

rows.proof_boundary: Termwise comparison in row 10; no limiting interchange or arithmetic estimate is used.
rows.statement: R_alpha<infinity iff sum_(N>=1)P_(alpha/2,N)/N<infinity.

rows.proof_boundary: Compose rows 8 and 11. The global stable-prefix family contains exactly the missing weighted-prefix anchor energy.
rows.statement: E_alpha<infinity iff R_alpha<infinity iff sum_(N>=1)P_(alpha/2,N)/N<infinity.

rows.proof_boundary: Compose row 12 with the already checked weighted-prefix/Mertens cofinal RH criterion. This is an equivalent target, not a proof that any series converges.
rows.statement: For any fixed cofinal sequence alpha_j->0 in (0,1), RH iff sum_(N>=1)P_(alpha_j/2,N)/N<infinity for every j.

rows.proof_boundary: The recovery is global in N and must not be confused with a bound from one tail value or one q-block.
rows.statement: The fixed-cutoff constant anchor is not an independent mode once the complete adjacent-cutoff tail sequence is retained: row 3 reconstructs it exactly.

rows.proof_boundary: The earlier constant-tail countermodel remains valid locally; the new result adds cross-cutoff compatibility rather than invalidating that guard.
rows.statement: At one fixed cutoff, adding a constant to the observed prefix block still leaves its post-prefix discrepancy unchanged.

rows.proof_boundary: Summing the critical tail envelope gives the boundary power. Its contribution to E_alpha is of harmonic size.
rows.statement: The critical pointwise rate r_N=O(N^(-(1+alpha)/2)) yields at best A_alpha(N)=O(N^((1-alpha)/2)) from row 3.

rows.proof_boundary: Uniform stable-prefix control supplies the critical pointwise tail rate, whereas the anchor energy requires a logarithmic mean-square gain across cutoffs.
rows.statement: sup_N P_(omega,N)<infinity does not imply sum_N P_(omega,N)/N<infinity.

rows.proof_boundary: A positive scalar/operator model with the same adjacent-tail algebra; it is not a model of the Mobius signs.
rows.statement: Let gamma=(1+alpha)/2, r_N=(N+1)^(-gamma), and a_N=N[r_(N-1)-r_N]. Then r_N=sum_(n>N)a_n/n.

rows.proof_boundary: The mean-value theorem and gamma>alpha for 0<alpha<1.
rows.statement: The scalar model satisfies 0<a_N<=gamma*N^(-gamma)<=gamma*N^(-alpha).

rows.proof_boundary: Insert r_N=(N+1)^(-gamma) into row 9 and use row 10.
rows.statement: For the scalar model, 2^(-(1+alpha))/(1+alpha)<=P_N<=1 for every N>=1.

rows.proof_boundary: This realizes the logarithmic boundary exactly.
rows.statement: For the scalar model, sum_N P_N/N diverges, and A(N)~[gamma/(1-gamma)]N^(1-gamma), so N^(alpha-2)A(N)^2 is asymptotic to a positive constant/N.

rows.proof_boundary: It does not disprove a Mobius-specific cancellation theorem and makes no claim about the actual value of P_(omega,N).
rows.statement: The scalar model proves that no generic operator argument using only the critical pointwise tail rate and coefficient size can close the logarithmic series.

rows.proof_boundary: Do not advertise the logarithmic P criterion as an extra condition that must be added after the full Q theorem.
rows.statement: The one-log obstruction concerns the stable-prefix component P alone. A cofinal uniform bound for the full Burnol energy Q would already imply RH through the existing three-gate criterion.

rows.proof_boundary: Those sources motivate the coordinate but are not cited as proving rows 2-13.
rows.statement: Burnol and Baez-Duarte supply the natural Mobius Nyman-Beurling framework; weighted Dirichlet and Hardy-space work supplies nearby zero-free and approximation criteria.

rows.proof_boundary: This is a search report, not a novelty or priority claim; a referee-level literature review remains appropriate.
rows.statement: A focused search of the cited primary sources found no exact displayed match for sum_N P_(omega,N)/N and the three-way equivalence in row 12.

rows.proof_boundary: Equivalently prove the weighted-prefix/Mertens energy. The reduction supplies no arithmetic cancellation and proves neither RH, PF-infinity, nor Lambda<=0.
rows.statement: Prove for the actual Mobius tail, on a fixed cofinal sequence alpha_j->0, the logarithmic estimate sum_N P_(alpha_j/2,N)/N<infinity without assuming RH.
